title: Rate Limiter Middleware
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build an Express.js application with a custom rate limiter middleware. The middleware should limit each IP to a configurable number of requests per time window. Apply it to all routes with a maximum of 5 requests per 60 seconds. When the limit is exceeded, return 429 with `{ "error": "Too many requests", "retryAfter": <seconds remaining> }`. Add a GET `/api/data` endpoint that returns `{ "message": "Success" }`. Set the `X-RateLimit-Remaining` header on every response.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Use Express.js
- Implement a custom middleware without external rate-limiter packages
- Track limits per IP
- Make the limit configuration reusable
- Export the app with `module.exports = app`

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
constraints: Implement a custom middleware without external rate-limiter packages
